name: scroll-scrub-hero
description: Build a scroll-scrubbed hero from one or two real photos, or from a written idea alone. A multimodal model storyboards from the photo, an image model renders keyframe stills image-to-image so the real property stays recognisable, a human approves a contact sheet, Kling 3.0 tweens between consecutive stills, and ffmpeg cuts the result into drop-in WebP frames plus a config file.
